entities.summary: Ram Singh Thakur was an Indian freedom fighter, musician and composer. He was an Indian Gorkha. He composed a number of patriotic songs including Qadam Qadam Badhaye Ja and Shubh Sukh Chain whilst serving in the Indian National Army.
